description: This file implements the 'remote-ext' command used in the Git source code. It handles parsing of command-line arguments, processing special URL syntax, and communicating with external commands over a bidirectional transport. It provides the core functionality for executing remote extension commands that involve custom URL-to-command mappings within the Git infrastructure.

methods.name: char * strip_escapes(const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
methods.description: Processes URL escape sequences in remote extension URLs, replacing placeholders like %s, %S, %G, %V with appropriate service or request parameters.

methods.name: void parse_argv(struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Expands arguments containing escape sequences into a list of arguments suitable for executing the remote command.

methods.name: void send_git_request(int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)
methods.description: Sends the constructed repository request over a file descriptor, optionally including virtual host information.

methods.name: int run_child(const char * arg,const char * service)
methods.description: Starts the specified external command and manages communication with it, including sending requests and transferring data.

methods.name: int command_loop(const char * child)
methods.description: Main loop that reads commands from stdin, processes 'connect' commands to run remote commands, and handles protocol interactions.

methods.name: int cmd_remote_ext(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Entry point for the 'remote-ext' command; validates arguments and initiates the command loop.

ctags.name: cmd_remote_ext
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: parse_argv
ctags.pattern: /^static void parse_argv(struct strvec *out, const char *arg, const char *service)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * out,const char * arg,const char * service)

ctags.pattern: /^static void send_git_request(int stdin_fd, const char *serv, const char *repo,$/
ctags.signature: (int stdin_fd,const char * serv,const char * repo,const char * vhost)

ctags.name: strip_escapes
ctags.signature: (const char * str,const char * service,const char ** next)
